policy_text.label_1: 1. Information We Collect: We may collect Personal Identification Information (Name, Email, Phone, Address), Technical Data (IP, Browser type, OS), Usage Data, and Marketing Preferences.
policy_text.label_2: 2. How We Collect Your Information: Through direct interactions, automated technologies, and third parties.
policy_text.label_3: 3. Use of Information: To provide and maintain our service, manage your account, comply with legal obligations, and improve our offerings.
policy_text.label_4: 4. Disclosure of Information: To service providers, legal and government authorities, and in connection with business transfers.
policy_text.label_5: 5. Data Security and Retention: We implement security measures and retain your data only as long as necessary.
policy_text.label_6: 6. Your Legal Rights: You have rights to access, correct, erase, restrict, transfer, and withdraw consent to the use of your data.
policy_text.label_7: 7. Special Category: I explicitly consent to the processing of any special category data I provide, including information relating to my ethnicity and other sensitive personal data for the purpose of responding to my query. I can withdraw my consent at any time by emailing info@lawneeds.co.uk.
policy_text.policy_details: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our mobile application. By using our service, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.

our_philosophy.our_vision_desc: At LawNeeds, we believe trusted legal help, especially immigration support should be accessible for everyone, anytime and anywhere. With smartphones at the heart of daily life, we’re here to help individuals navigate life in the UK through easy, reliable legal assistance.
our_philosophy.our_services_desc: Our mobile application, exclusively featuring regulated law firms, licensed lawyers and immigration advisers, offers specialised legal services with a strong focus on Immigration Law. We support individuals, families, students, professionals and growing businesses in navigating life in the UK. As we grow, users will also access expertise in Employment Law, Family Law, and Road Traffic Offences, all delivered with the same seamless, hassle-free experience in just a few taps.
our_philosophy.innovation_desc: At LawNeeds, innovation drives everything we do. We harness the power of AI to deliver immediate, around-the-clock, AI-generated legal guidance and personalised immigration recommendations based on each user’s location and situation for flexible in-app consultations with regulated lawyers and advisers.
our_philosophy.community_desc: LawNeeds is more than an app — it’s a community. We empower migrants, and equip legal professionals to grow their practice through our innovative platform and features.
our_philosophy.commitment_desc: LawNeeds combines AI technology with human legal oversight. Our platform is trained on proprietary UK legal dataset, reviewed by in-house lawyers, alongside our verification system, and continuously updated with regulatory changes and verified sources of law, ensuring trusted support every step of the way.
our_philosophy.join_us_desc: As we continue to grow, we invite you to join our journey, whether you're seeking legal help or expanding your legal practice. At LawNeeds, your success is our mission.
